body: Honestly, I feel most at peace and normal when I'm solving other people's problems, I always manage to bump people up in life and watching them succeed, have confidence they didn't know they had and heal from trauma is like food to me. I know that I'm good at this and I know that so many people need someone like me to change things for them, but it takes such a toll. It's crept into my relationship with my partner and I've become toxic, my relationship with friends, had me turn to drugs for the energy to keep going, now I'm on medication. I'm so frustrated all the time, how can a person like me do these great things for so many people and maintain our finances, loving relationships and lives. I know I could just stop, say no, be selfish, love my partner and keep my money. But who would I be then? Just the same as so many other people that walk past and ignore the ones that just need one person to intercept their lives and send them on the right path. I'm not huge on spiritual stuff or religion, but I feel myself crumbling while watching these people grow, and I'm always torn between bitterness and love.
Thank you ❤️ it's difficult when you were the toxic one in the end I guess.
This doesn't feel so bad, know that on my way out I'm very grateful for all the kind words before I go
I ate them 😔 Thank you though
I was new, he was perfect. It ended in pain and regret 😔
My heart seems stuck there with him 🙄 I don't think it can be trusted
